methodology.market_data_source: TradingView Official OHLCV for CAPITALCOM symbols
methodology.receipt_source: TradingView alert fire history where retrievable
methodology.decision_source_rule: Use alert-time OHLCV/EMA20/EMA50/RSI14/ATR14 when receipt is available; reconstruct only missing EMA200/ADX14/zscore20 causally from TradingView OHLCV. When receipt is unavailable, reconstruct the entire snapshot from historical OHLCV.
methodology.cost_rule: Protocol sensitivity only: subtract total friction bps * 1e-4 * entry / (1.5 * source ATR) from gross R on completed outcomes.
methodology.caveat: Protocol receipt does not contain EMA200, ADX14 or zscore20; these decision-material features remain reconstructed, so directional observations are research-only and not prospective promotion-grade evidence.
